answer: Tie rewards to scarce, verifiable work rather than identity count. Tasks are dealt at random and graders picked by lot, so a sybil swarm cannot steer its clones onto an island of easy jobs and friendly reviews. Payouts wait a week in escrow while spot audits act as a lantern, rechecking past results; any clone caught copying or colluding forfeits its stake. No single vertex of the graph can mint trust for its own copies, so fakes pay to exist and earn nothing.
